source: Released VGI Trading Calendar v0.5.0, tested with exchange-calendars 4.13.3; no HTTP feed or replay fixture. Source tag pinned; transitive dependencies may resolve newer versions.
semantics: Modeled regular-session open/close instants. No observed trades, real-time halts, extended hours or guarantees of venue availability.
boundary_probes: 2026-10-19 is a covered open Monday; 2026-10-24 a covered closed Saturday; 1900-01-01 is outside the default calendar window.
synthetic_event_controls: Two invented instants exactly at the first selected shared interval start/end verify half-open membership.
